description:
My family is uncomfortable. I hate my older brother. Just like this... I wish I could disappear. Jeong In-Hye, a freshman in the Department of Fine Arts, is experiencing a hectic freshman year with her roommate, Ahn Soo-Jin. Soo-Jin enjoys campus life without any worries, but as she spends more time with him, In-Hye begins to feel inferior, reliving trauma from her past family. She struggles to maintain her daily life with her passion for art, but an inexplicable surge of impulse only alienates her from those around her. Ryu Mu-Yeong, a classmate who seems to see through her inner self, tries to get closer to her... but campus life is mired in love, hate, and obsession. Amidst this, a black-and-white psychodrama races to find light: "Perhaps... This Is a Form of Love?"

(Source: Lezhin, translated)
